verdict.rationale: The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the common paths it checked. Brave does publish machine-readable alternatives: an llms.txt and per-endpoint API reference pages in markdown (e.g. suggestions, spell check, rich search, local POIs). These are a loose stand-in for a formal spec, not a downloadable OpenAPI-equivalent document. Missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent schema) file, documentation pointing to where such a spec lives, and independent confirmation that agents can consume it.
